PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m evaluation.venue2027.dimva.independent_oracle # built-in independence + rule-table self-scan

notes: P02 DIMVA-oracle deliverable: evaluation/venue2027/dimva/independent_oracle.py implements adjudicate(case) -> OracleResult by DELEGATING every decision to the audited shared kernel evaluation.venue2027._shared.oracle_kernel.adjudicate (v1.0.0) driven by the module-local declarative DIMVA detection rule table DIMVA_DETECTION_RULES frozen per the preregistered CASE_MATRIX: benign_session -> REJECT meaning 'not an attack' (DIMVA-CASE-01/04 specificity control: legitimate retry, care-team handoff), low_and_slow -> ADMIT (DIMVA-CASE-03: long sparse horizon with escalating lineage reuse paced under fixed windows), cross_tool_obfuscation -> ADMIT (DIMVA-CASE-02 purpose-hopping / renamed-tool denials to defeat signatures), burst_probe -> ADMIT (DIMVA-CASE-05: compressed inter-arrival probing bursts); unknown/undeclared family -> INDETERMINATE via kernel fail-closed codes UNMODELLED_FAMILY / NO_FAMILY_DECLARED so an unmodelled situation is never silently treated as 'not an attack'. DETECTION-venue label semantics (documented in LABEL_SEMANTICS and machine-checked via CAMPAIGN_TRUTH_LABELS): ADMIT means the campaign IS malicious — admitted into the attack-campaign class (oracle truth label ATTACK); REJECT means the case is NOT an attack (benign session, truth label BENIGN); INDETERMINATE is retained for blinded human adjudication (PENDING_ADJUDICATION). This axis is deliberately inverted relative to the detector arms' harness outcome vocabulary (a DETECT alarm is recorded as a harness REJECT); the oracle labels campaign truth, never a detector arm's alarm decision — tests pin the inversion so it cannot be silently 'fixed'. ORACLE_ID='dimva-campaign-truth-reference' stamped on every verdict. Ground truth derives only from the declared scenario family and the frozen rule table per GATES/INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL.md rule 2 (security truth from event-sequence/policy ground truth, never candidate reason codes): candidate-supplied decision fields inside a case (observed_decision, verdict, score, reason_code) are ignored by construction, so circular label generation is impossible; this is asserted in tests with poisoned cases in both directions. NO candidate/baseline import: CANDIDATE_BASENAMES=('dimva.baselines','baselines') scanned with ast by verify_independence() (whole-target and dotted-component exact match, so 'baselines_suite' is not tripped), dynamic __import__ / importlib.import_module flagged as '__dynamic__' for review rather than guessed safe, and the audited kernel guard oracle_kernel.assert_oracle_independence runs on the live file as well; tests prove refusal of plain/aliased/from-import/dotted/relative/rogue-on-disk-oracle candidate imports (CANDIDATE_IMPORT) plus live-source tampering control. NO LLM/model call anywhere (pure deterministic rule table, no network, no provider, no hidden clock, no randomness; synthetic fixtures only, no real PHI/PII). Built-in self_scan() runs the independence scan plus an ORACLE_RULE_DRIFT guard pinning DIMVA_DETECTION_RULES to the frozen four-family registry and the self-check matrix (REJECT, ADMIT, ADMIT, ADMIT, INDETERMINATE), reporting llm_calls=0 / model_imports=0. All errors are stable uppercase reason codes on oracle_kernel.OracleError (MALFORMED_CASE, MISSING_CASE_ID, NO_FAMILY_DECLARED, UNMODELLED_FAMILY, ORACLE_RULE_DRIFT, CANDIDATE_IMPORT, UNKNOWN_OUTCOME); INDETERMINATE is first-class and never coerced to a safe verdict (false-zero ban). test_independent_oracle.py: 36 tests pass (positive: per-family outcomes, nested payload family, rule-table = frozen registry, determinism, JSON round-trip with kernel version binding, self-check matrix, manual canonical-history sentinel parity with CASE_MATRIX, label-semantics prose/mapping/inversion pins; adversarial: rogue temp oracle file refused, candidate import variants refused, dynamic import flagged, tampered live source refused, kernel AST guard clean, similar names not tripped, poisoned candidate fields cannot flip the verdict, missing case_id / malformed case fail-closed, unmodelled/missing family stay INDETERMINATE as PENDING_ADJUDICATION, evidence-ref tamper control). Full evaluation/venue2027 suite: 1103 passed. uvx ruff@0.7.1 check + format --check clean on touched files (exit 0). No detection efficacy claim is made here: this oracle supplies campaign truth labels only; detector arms (DIMVA-baselines / candidate) are evaluated separately against these labels per the frozen protocol. source_sha_after = base SHA 11a9219c per established repo convention (proof report committed together with the work in the task's single commit).
